description: Five CLI agents on Linux, all found through identifiers the catalog already had.
why: THE POINT OF THE LINUX PORT IN ONE SCENARIO: not one identifier here was added for Linux. The npm route and the `~/`-rooted path routes were always portable, so what was missing was queries that look under /home and /root and a matcher whose HOME_ROOTS resolves them. If this passes, the portable half of the catalog works on Linux with no catalog edit at all.
known_gaps: Claude Code's npm identifier is not exercised here -- the native installer is its primary route and the two would fight over the same binary name. 21-cli-agents-homebrew makes the same argument on macOS.
